store.description: The 1998 sci-fi shooter, running in the browser through a WebAssembly port of Xash3D. Wake up in Black Mesa, pick up a crowbar and fight through the resonance cascade to the Xen borderworld.
features: The full single-player campaign — Black Mesa to Xen
Mouse-look via pointer lock: click the view once to capture the mouse
WASD to move, Ctrl to crouch, Space to jump, E to use
Embedded client — no download, no account
Reload and Open-in-Browser toolbar if the frame is blocked
